official_sources.title: GDAL raster nodata masks and valid-percent metadata
official_sources.finding: GDAL raster bands may carry nodata values and mask bands, and statistics metadata can expose STATISTICS_VALID_PERCENT for the percentage of non-nodata pixels.
official_sources.limitation: A valid-percent statistic can be stale, approximate or dataset-wide; parcel-window support must be recomputed from the exact native mask.

official_sources.title: GDAL RFC 15 valid-data mask convention
official_sources.finding: GDAL RFC 15 represents masks as UInt8 bands where zero means invalid or nodata and nonzero, normally 255, means valid data.
official_sources.limitation: An all-valid synthetic mask can be returned when no explicit mask exists, so provenance and mask flags must be recorded.

official_sources.title: Rasterio mask precedence and 8-bit nodata collision warning
official_sources.finding: Rasterio distinguishes GDAL valid-data masks from inverse NumPy masks, applies dataset-mask precedence, and documents that valid low values can collide with an 8-bit nodata sentinel after scaling.
official_sources.limitation: A sidecar .msk can override nodata metadata; both the main raster and sidecar identity must be bound to the same asset version.

official_sources.title: GDAL warp source validity and interpolation behavior
official_sources.finding: GDAL warp excludes source pixels invalidated by nodata, masks or alpha from interpolation and marks a target pixel nodata when no valid contributors remain.
official_sources.limitation: Warping changes the support set and can resample values; final parcel extrema should use native data unless a justified transformation path is explicitly accepted.

official_sources.title: GDAL unified multiband nodata semantics
official_sources.finding: GDAL defines YES, NO and PARTIAL modes for combining nodata across multiple source bands, with behavior and defaults changing across GDAL versions.
official_sources.limitation: Implicit version-dependent defaults can change validity; the exact mode and GDAL version must be recorded.

official_sources.title: USGS DEM nodata, PixelIsArea and edge-quality requirements
official_sources.finding: USGS LBS 2025 rev. A requires DEM voids to use -999999 in the GDAL_NODATA tag, requires PixelIsArea, and rejects edge artifacts or mismatches in tiled DEM delivery.
official_sources.limitation: These are USGS 3DEP requirements and cannot be assumed for a different provider without matching product documentation.

official_sources.title: USGS lidar data void rejection examples
official_sources.finding: USGS examples identify insufficiently covered areas as data voids and state that such voids are grounds for rejection of the project.
official_sources.limitation: Project-level void criteria do not directly define a parcel-specific minimum valid-cell ratio; that threshold must be declared for the target analysis.

official_sources.title: Rasterio geometry mask cell-inclusion policy
official_sources.finding: Rasterio mask uses pixel-centre inclusion by default and offers an all-touched mode that includes every pixel touched by geometry.
official_sources.limitation: Neither policy is universally correct; the choice affects valid support and extrema and must be fixed before computation.
